negative_findings.description: J&T Finance Group SE and PPF are privately held and run no conventional investor-relations site with quarterly presentations; disclosure is limited to annual (and for J&T, semi-annual) statutory/bond-issuer reports plus press releases, largely in Czech/Slovak.
negative_findings.result_summary: Found consolidated annual reports (JTFG SE 2024 PDF; PPF Group annual accounts 2022/2024/2025) but no quarterly segment reporting, no results presentations, no fact books.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The domestically-controlled part of the SK banking market (J&T Banka SK, 365.bank, Postova banka; Home Credit SK) will be observable only at annual frequency and with far less granularity than Erste/KBC/RBI/Intesa units — a permanent asymmetry in any quarterly SK market model.

negative_findings.description: Slovak-language searching for the parent-IR channel itself (queries using 'materska skupina', 'prezentacia pre investorov', 'segment Slovensko', 'stvrtrocne vysledky') returned almost no parent-published Slovak material.
negative_findings.result_summary: SK queries surfaced subsidiary annual reports, SK/CZ trade press and aggregators (finstat.sk, teraz.sk, patria.cz, e15.cz, kurzy.cz) rather than parent IR pages. Parents publish this channel in English (and German/Italian/Dutch), not Slovak.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Confirms a structural rule for this cell: local-language crawling is the wrong instrument for parent IR. SK terms are still essential for the subsidiary mirrors and for SK/CZ media that relay parent numbers, so both language tracks must be kept but pointed at different targets.

negative_findings.description: Several parents serve report files from cache-busting or hashed CDN paths that cannot be templated: KBC (wcmassets.kbc.be/.../<file>.pdf.cdn.res/last-modified/<epoch>/<file>.pdf), RBI (*.coredownload.pdf/.xlsm), PPF (datocms-assets.com/<id>/<epoch>-<name>.pdf), J&T (kc-usercontent.com GUID paths).
negative_findings.result_summary: Direct file URLs observed in search results, but each embeds a timestamp or GUID that changes on republication.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A collector that hardcodes these URLs will silently rot. Link resolution must always start from the HTML index page, and stored URLs should be treated as snapshots, not durable identifiers.

negative_findings.description: No URL in this slice is claimed as verified-live. Only three pages were actually fetched in this pass (Erste financial-reports index, RBI reports page, Intesa subsidiaries-annual-reports page); all others come from search-result metadata.

negative_findings.why_it_matters: SK subsidiary-level analyst validation must come from EBA transparency data, NBS, registeruz filings and parent-group segment reporting rather than SSM aggregates.

negative_findings.description: No EDGAR-style single full-text, machine-readable filing archive exists for Slovak banks. Disclosure is split between RÚZ (accounting statements), CERI (regulated information from securities issuers) and issuers' own IR pages; none offers EDGAR-like full-text search across all filings.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searched sk and en for a consolidated SK filing search engine; found only the three separate silos plus commercial aggregators.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Any time-series build must join at least RÚZ + CERI + issuer sites on IČO/LEI; budget for reconciliation rather than expecting one archive.

negative_findings.description: Could not confirm an active 'Cribis Universal Register' product offered for Slovakia by Dun & Bradstreet/Bisnode; search returned only the Bisnode→D&B Slovakia rename (effective 2022) and generic D&B products.
negative_findings.result_summary: No SK Cribis landing page surfaced in either language.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Avoids recording a non-existent SK product line; the CRIF/Cribis family may cover SK under a different brand and needs a dedicated check.

negative_findings.description: The OpenCorporates Slovakia jurisdiction URL was inferred from the platform's standard URL pattern rather than confirmed in search results, and no bulk SK export offer was found.
negative_findings.result_summary: English query returned only generic OpenCorporates commentary about indexing the SK commercial register.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Treat that candidate's URL and bulk availability as unverified until the deterministic liveness pass runs.

negative_findings.description: No established Slovak-language term was found for 'machine-readable mirror' or 'bulk download archive' as a category; practitioners use borrowed English ('SQL dump', 'API', 'dataset') inside Slovak sentences.
negative_findings.result_summary: Local-language searching had to rely on 'otvorené dáta', 'hromadné stiahnutie' and English-in-Slovak terms.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Future query expansion for this cell should mix Slovak nouns with English technical tokens rather than seeking pure-Slovak equivalents.

negative_findings.description: No dedicated Slovak POS/acquiring/terminal industry conference was found. sk queries on payments conferences returned general fintech/banking events (Finweek, FinNext, ITAPA) rather than an acceptance/terminal-specific venue.
negative_findings.result_summary: Payments-hardware and acquiring topics appear only as sessions inside broader conferences, not as standalone SK events.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Acceptance-side milestones (terminal counts, softPOS, eKasa integration) must be harvested from session-level programmes rather than from a single dedicated venue - raises collection cost and the chance of missing a signal.

negative_findings.description: LinkedIn - the seed query's named channel for CEO/bank milestone announcements - is login-walled and its ToS restricts automated collection. Search returned only company/profile landing pages, no post-level content.
negative_findings.result_summary: Individual milestone posts could not be enumerated from open search; only the company page URL and secondary reporting of post content were obtainable.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A core surface of this cell (executive communication) cannot be collected automatically without a licensed feed; the routine must plan for manual monitoring or accept lag via press-room mirrors.

negative_findings.description: No page was fetched directly in this pass; all candidate URLs come from search-result metadata and snippets. Liveness, robots.txt posture and paywall status are therefore hypotheses, not verdicts.
negative_findings.result_summary: All URLs recorded unverified by design; deterministic liveness pass required.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Downstream collectors must not assume any URL here is reachable; a 403 on e.g. mastercard.com or forbes.sk should be read as bot-defence, not as a dead source.

negative_findings.description: Two apparently distinct Slovak fintech association web presences were found - finas.sk (FINAS, active meetups, awards, expansion hub) and slovakfintech.sk (eventy/novinky, Open Banking platform). Their relationship (rename, split, or two bodies) was not resolved.
negative_findings.result_summary: Both listed as separate candidates pending clarification.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Risk of double-counting the same association's events, or of dropping the still-active one if they are merged incorrectly.

negative_findings.description: No established Slovak-language term was identified for 'earnings call' / 'investor day' in the SK bank context - SK banks are largely subsidiaries of foreign groups (Erste, Intesa, RBI, KBC) and do not hold local earnings calls, so the spoken-disclosure channel is conferences and awards rather than IR events.
negative_findings.result_summary: sk queries for executive result presentations returned conference and award content, not IR calls.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Confirms the premise of this cell: for SK, group-level IR (Vienna/Milan/Brussels) plus local conference/award stages together substitute for a domestic earnings-call channel; the routine should also watch parent-group IR.

negative_findings.description: Searched in Slovak for an open dataset or API exposing the Zbierka listín (commercial register document collection) itself. data.gov.sk and the MS SR open-data page point to register APIs (RPVS, ress-isu Swagger) but no evidence was found of a bulk, machine-readable feed of the scanned listiny.
negative_findings.result_summary: Document lists appear reachable per-entity via orsr.sk zbl.asp; full documents are requested via sluzby.orsr.sk, seemingly with eID and/or a court fee.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Corporate-action monitoring for non-listed SK banks/PSPs will need per-entity polling rather than a bulk feed, which raises collection cost and argues for prioritising a watchlist.

negative_findings.description: No official English-language interface was found for registeruz.sk or orsr.sk; English search results consistently redirect to commercial intermediaries (FinStat English services, Schmidt & Schmidt) or the EU BRIS node.
negative_findings.result_summary: English-only collection of the SK statutory channel is not viable; Slovak-language parsing of form templates and document labels is required.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Downstream extraction must handle Slovak field names (súvaha, výkaz ziskov a strát, poznámky, správa audítora); budget for a Slovak term mapping layer.

negative_findings.description: The domain registeructovnychzavierok.sk closely mimics the official registeruz.sk but is a private explainer site, not the statutory register.
negative_findings.result_summary: Recorded as low-credibility context source; official register is registeruz.sk (MF SR / DataCentrum).
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Prevents a collector or analyst from citing a non-authoritative site as the statutory source.

negative_findings.description: Several URLs recorded here (rpvs.gov.sk root, api.statistics.sk/rpo/v1/, sluzby.orsr.sk, the Slovensko.Digital S3 dump link) were referenced by search results or documentation pages but not individually fetched in this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: Recorded with URL + confidence only; no liveness claim made, per run rules.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The deterministic verification pass should prioritise these before a collector is built against them.

negative_findings.description: Searched in Slovak for a dedicated statutory filing channel specific to platobné inštitúcie / inštitúcie elektronických peňazí (separate from the generic RÚZ). None was found; NBS registers list authorisations but appear not to host the entities' own financial statements.
negative_findings.result_summary: Payment-institution accounts must be sourced from the generic RÚZ, keyed by IČO obtained from NBS lists.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Confirms the pointer→direct chain (NBS actor list → RPO IČO → RÚZ filings) as the correct architecture for this cell.

negative_findings.description: Searched CERI's own documentation pages (/docs, /categories, /manuals) for an API, RSS feed, bulk export or open-data dump of regulated information. None is documented: the site advertises only a database search UI with print/download of individual documents.
negative_findings.result_summary: No API/RSS/bulk-download endpoint found for ceri.nbs.sk. Collection will require HTML crawling of the search interface plus per-document file retrieval.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Sets the engineering cost and fragility of the single most important source in this cell, and strengthens the case for planning a migration to ESAP structured access from 2027.

negative_findings.description: Every direct WebFetch attempt against www.bsse.sk returned 'connect ECONNREFUSED 195.80.190.46:443'. Search engines index the same URLs and PDFs hosted on bsse.sk appear in results, so the site is very likely live.
negative_findings.result_summary: bsse.sk not fetchable from this environment; treated as bot-defended/geo-restricted, NOT dead. Content for BCPB candidates was reconstructed from search-result metadata and NBS descriptions rather than direct reading.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The exchange is a core node of this cell. If the block is IP-based, the deterministic verification pass and the eventual collector must run from an EU egress or via a headless browser; otherwise the whole BCPB branch will be falsely marked dead.

negative_findings.description: Searched in both Slovak and English for a public, per-bank MREL/resolution disclosure register for Slovakia (e.g. a Rada pre riešenie krízových situácií / resolution council publication of bank-level MREL targets or eligible-liability issuance). No such Slovak national register surfaced within this run.
negative_findings.result_summary: No SK-specific public MREL disclosure store identified; MREL-eligible senior instruments appear only indirectly via issuer prospectuses and CERI filings.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: MREL issuance is one of the stated triggers for this cell's regulated-disclosure flow; without a dedicated register, MREL intelligence must be reconstructed from prospectuses, Pillar 3 reports and parent-group disclosures, which is slower and less complete.

negative_findings.description: Slovak-language searching for foreign-venue listings of Slovak bank instruments (e.g. covered bonds or senior notes listed in Luxembourg or Vienna rather than on BCPB) produced no clear local-language term or index. Slovak terminology exists for the instruments (kryté dlhopisy, hypotekárne záložné listy) but not for a 'foreign listing venue' concept that search engines resolve.
negative_findings.result_summary: Could not establish, in this run, whether and where SK bank benchmark covered bonds are listed outside BCPB.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: If benchmark issues are listed abroad, the SK regulated-disclosure channel (CERI/BCPB) would be incomplete for the largest transactions, and the collection plan would need a foreign-OAM branch.

negative_findings.description: CERI documentation states that filings submitted before 31 July 2011 may require in-person consultation at NBS headquarters by appointment, even though electronic storage nominally begins 1 June 2007.
negative_findings.result_summary: Pre-2011 regulated information is only partially available online.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Caps the depth of any automated long-run time series for SK bank disclosure at roughly 2011 without manual archival work.

negative_findings.description: The Slovak phrase 'Pilier 3' / '3. pilier' is heavily overloaded. It most commonly means the third pension pillar (doplnkové dôchodkové sporenie) in consumer-facing content, and secondarily the Solvency II insurance Pillar III. Banking CRR Pillar 3 results were repeatedly crowded out by pension articles (podnikajte.sk, banky.sk).
negative_findings.result_summary: Effective SK queries must avoid bare 'Pilier 3' and instead use 'opatrenie NBS č. 16/2014', 'uverejňovanie informácií bankami', 'informácie o banke k <date>', or 'informácie o činnosti banky'.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A naive SK keyword collector on 'Pilier 3' will return mostly pension-product marketing and near-zero prudential disclosure, silently producing a false coverage gap.

negative_findings.description: No official standalone website for Garančný fond investícií (Investment Guarantee Fund) was located in this pass, despite it being an NBS-supervised statutory body under Act 566/2001 §80 with an annual-reporting obligation. Only third-party descriptions (fio.sk PDF, fininfo.sk, finstat.sk) surfaced.
negative_findings.result_summary: GFI recorded as a lower-confidence candidate pointing at secondary sources; its primary domain remains unidentified.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: GFI is the investor-protection counterpart to FOV and belongs in the same compelled-disclosure family; leaving its primary channel unmapped is a real hole in this cell.

negative_findings.description: The Rezolučná rada's 'Vybrané právoplatné rozhodnutia' page appears to contain no published decisions to date.
negative_findings.result_summary: Recorded as a source to monitor rather than as a data source, since a first entry would be a high-signal resolution event.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Distinguishing 'channel exists but is empty' from 'channel does not exist' matters — the former is a live tripwire, the latter is a gap. This is the former.

negative_findings.description: SRB MREL dashboards are aggregate across the SRB remit; no SK-country or SK-bank-level MREL breakdown was found in the dashboard publications, and no Slovakia-specific MREL disclosure list was found on srb.europa.eu.
negative_findings.result_summary: Bank-level MREL for SK institutions must be sourced from each bank's own Pillar 3 / MREL disclosure, not from the SRB dashboard.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Prevents an incorrect collection design that expects country-level MREL series from the SRB.

negative_findings.description: No dedicated disclosure landing pages were located this pass for Privatbanka, a.s., Slovenská záručná a rozvojová banka, a.s. (SZRB), UniCredit Bank Czech Republic and Slovakia (SK branch), or Wüstenrot stavebná sporiteľňa, despite all of them being subject to Opatrenie 16/2014.
negative_findings.result_summary: Absent from the candidate list; requires a targeted per-domain navigation pass rather than keyword search.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Smaller and state-owned institutions have thin SEO footprints; keyword search systematically under-covers them, biasing the source map toward the big four.

negative_findings.description: No NBS page was found publishing bank-level ICAAP/ILAAP outcomes, SREP capital requirements (P2R), or O-SII/systemic-risk buffer decisions per institution, though NBS is the designated macroprudential authority and such decisions are normally published.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searched with SK macroprudential terms ('makroprudenciálna politika', 'vankúš', 'ozdravné plány') and hit only institutional/history pages.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: P2R and buffer decisions are a compelled, structured, bank-level supervisory disclosure stream — arguably the highest-value part of this cell — and it is currently unmapped.

negative_findings.description: The guessed Slovak-language NBS path https://nbs.sk/dohlad-nad-financnym-trhom/dohlad/platobne-sluzby-a-elektronicke-peniaze/platobne-institucie/ returned HTTP 404 on one fetch attempt.
negative_findings.result_summary: Only the English-language equivalents under /en/financial-market-supervision1/supervision/payment-services-and-electronic-money/ were confirmed in search results. The SK slug likely differs rather than being absent; treat as unverified, not dead.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Slovak-language regulator pages are the preferred citation for a SK cell; the correct SK slug must be resolved from the NBS site navigation before collection is automated.

negative_findings.description: Targeted Slovak-language searching for press releases or investor pages of several NBS-licensed payment institutions (Payout a.s., K-PAY a.s., Ultima Payments a.s., BLIK SK, a.s.) returned no corporate newsroom.
negative_findings.result_summary: These entities surface only as register rows; no own-site disclosures located in this pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: For most SK payment institutions the ONLY reliable disclosure route is the statutory filing register (RÚZ) plus the commercial register, not company communications — collection design must assume filings-first.

negative_findings.description: No investor-relations function exists for the SK payments cell: no SK-domiciled payment or e-money institution was found to be listed on the Bratislava Stock Exchange or to publish IR material.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches for investor relations / earnings material for SK PIs returned nothing; the sector is entirely privately held or foreign-parented.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The workstream topics 'investor relations' and 'earnings' cannot be satisfied at SK entity level for payments; earnings signals must be taken from group-level IR of foreign parents (e.g. Global Payments Inc.) or from RÚZ filings.

negative_findings.description: Several local-language search terms proved noisy.
negative_findings.result_summary: 'elektronické peniaze' pulls in Ministry of Finance consumer-education pages and FIU AML reports; 'výročná správa' alone pulls government-body annual reports; the abbreviation 'SBA' collides with the banking association and unrelated bodies; 'Trust Pay' collides with 'TRUST účtovná kancelária s. r. o.'.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Automated query generation for this cell must pin queries to entity IČO or to the exact licence-category phrase to avoid heavy false positives.

negative_findings.description: No named full inštitúcia elektronických peňazí list was retrieved directly from an NBS page in this pass; the NBS EMI page is definitional and defers to a 'List of subjects' link.
negative_findings.result_summary: SKPAY, a. s. was confirmed as a payment AND e-money institution via Slovenská pošta and its own site, but a complete SK EMI roster was not enumerated.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The EMI sub-population of this cell is currently under-enumerated relative to the payment-institution sub-population.

negative_findings.description: No dedicated Slovak-language newsroom or press-release archive was found for Visa or Mastercard covering Slovakia. SK-relevant scheme news (e.g. Click to Pay arriving in Slovakia) was only observable via the pan-European Mastercard newsroom and via SK tech-media pickup (touchit.sk).
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches in sk and en returned only global/Europe newsrooms plus a Mastercard Slovakia Instagram account; no sk press-release index.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: SK scheme announcements must be caught downstream (SK media, agency tag pages) rather than at source, which adds latency and attribution risk.

negative_findings.description: Neither Worldline nor Nexi discloses Slovakia as a reporting unit. Worldline group FY/H1 releases name Italy, Switzerland, UK, Germany, France and Belgium but not Slovakia; Nexi reports Slovakia only inside an aggregated CSEE segment alongside Poland, Croatia, Hungary and Serbia.
negative_findings.result_summary: No SK line item found in any group-level acquirer/processor disclosure reviewed.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: SK acquiring/processing revenue can only be reconstructed from SK statutory filings (registeruz/ORSR), not from group investor materials - this shapes the whole collection design for cell 07.

negative_findings.description: Two Global Payments SK legal vehicles appear as dissolved/in liquidation in Slovak registry aggregators: 'Global Payments Europe Slovakia, s.r.o. v likvidacii' (ICO 43854958) and 'Global Payments Europe, s.r.o., organizacna zlozka' (ICO 35893630). The live vehicle appears to be 'Global Payments s.r.o., organizacna zlozka' (ICO 50010301, Vajnorska 100/B, Bratislava).
negative_findings.result_summary: Registry-aggregator listings flag [zrusena]/v likvidacii for the two older entities.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collecting against a stale ICO would silently produce empty or misleading SK financials; the entity map for this actor must be pinned to ICO 50010301 and re-checked.

negative_findings.description: No separate Slovak-registered Worldline legal entity was identified in this pass. Worldline appears to serve SK through worldline.com/sk-sk, a platobnyterminal.sk.worldline.com subdomain and the chcemterminal.sk channel site, suggesting cross-border/branch service rather than a SK a.s./s.r.o.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches on 'Worldline Slovakia s.r.o.' and NBS listings returned no SK-incorporated Worldline entity.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: If there is no SK entity, no SK statutory accounts exist for Worldline and its SK footprint must be inferred from NBS passporting records and channel/pricing evidence instead.

negative_findings.description: The NBS PSD2 register API endpoint (https://subjekty.nbs.sk/api/psd2) and the ZBK statistics page (https://zbk.sk/statisticke-udaje/) were identified from search results but were not fetched in this pass, so their current response shape and content depth are unverified.
negative_findings.result_summary: Recorded as high-confidence candidates with unverified liveness; not treated as dead.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The deterministic verification pass should prioritise these two, as both are load-bearing for the actor map and the acceptance-side time series.

negative_findings.description: No public source was found disclosing SK merchant-acquiring market shares (by turnover or merchant/terminal count) split between Global Payments, Worldline, Nexi and bank-owned acquirers. ZBK and SBA statistics are aggregate, not per-acquirer.
negative_findings.result_summary: Both sk and en queries returned only aggregate card statistics and vendor marketing.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Any market-share view for SK acceptance will have to be modelled from statutory revenue filings plus terminal-estate proxies, not read off a published source.

negative_findings.description: Searched in Slovak for a standalone annual report of a SIPS operator company; SIPS has no separate operating company — it is run directly by NBS, so there is no 'prevádzkovateľ výročná správa' distinct from the NBS annual report.
negative_findings.result_summary: Only NBS pages and NBS annual reports returned; no independent clearing-house entity publishing accounts.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection must target NBS publications rather than hunting a non-existent Slovak ACH company; avoids wasted crawl budget and false 'missing source' gaps.

negative_findings.description: Bankové zúčtovacie centrum Slovenska, a.s. (BZCS), the pre-2003 interbank clearing operator, was renamed RVS, a.s. and appears in the commercial register as dissolved/in liquidation.
negative_findings.result_summary: Found NBS history page and FinStat register entry; no live corporate website or ongoing disclosure.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Historical clearing volumes must be sought in NBS annual reports and academic library holdings, not from the entity itself.

negative_findings.description: Slovak-language searching for Slovenská pošta postal payment transaction volumes (SIPO, poštový poukaz counts) returned product and tariff pages only, no published volume statistics on posta.sk.
negative_findings.result_summary: Volume data appears only, if at all, inside the annual report PDF and the RÚ universal-service report — not as a standing statistical page.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Postal payment volumes will require PDF text extraction rather than a structured feed; plan parsing effort accordingly.

negative_findings.description: No Slovak national instant-payment scheme body separate from the EPC SEPA Instant Credit Transfer scheme was identified; NBS and SBA act as the coordinating bodies.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches in Slovak for 'okamžité platby schéma prevádzkovateľ' returned only NBS topic pages and EPC-derived material.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Instant-payment scheme intelligence for SK must come from NBS, SBA and EPC-level sources rather than a domestic scheme operator.

negative_findings.description: The NBS 'Prístup do platobných systémov' PDF is served from an opaque document endpoint with a force-download query parameter; it was found only via search result metadata and was not fetched.
negative_findings.result_summary: URL recorded with medium-high confidence; liveness deliberately not asserted.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Deterministic verification pass should confirm; opaque GUID paths are fragile and may need re-discovery from the parent page each cycle.

negative_findings.description: Slovak-language searching on BNPL terms (odložená platba, platba na splátky, kúp teraz zaplať neskôr) returned almost exclusively Czech-market material (Twisto, Skip Pay, Platím Pak, Klarna, GoPay, Comgate) with only an incidental mention that Skip Pay operates in Slovakia.
negative_findings.result_summary: No SK-domiciled BNPL provider newsroom identified in this pass; SK BNPL appears to be served by CZ/EU providers rather than local actors.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The BNPL leg of the cell has no confirmed local primary source, so BNPL signals for SK will have to be pulled from CZ provider newsrooms, e-shop payment-method pages and NBS consumer-credit supervision instead.

negative_findings.description: No dedicated Slovak fintech-only newswire or press-release distribution channel (equivalent to a national fintech PR hub) was found; SK fintech PR is dispersed across FinReport, Forbes.sk, Startitup and company sites.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches in sk for 'tlačová správa fintech Slovensko' surfaced media articles, not a distribution platform.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection must be multi-source and keyword-driven rather than a single feed subscription; raises the risk of missing small announcements.

negative_findings.description: Company homepages for Fumbi, Vacuumlabs, kevin., 365.bank and Revolut newsroom paths were inferred from coverage rather than fetched in this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: URLs provided with reduced confidence; no liveness claim made.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The deterministic verification pass must resolve exact newsroom paths before these are wired into collection.

negative_findings.description: 'FINTECH SK s.r.o.' (IČO 54500923) exists as a registered SK company name, making the bare term 'fintech SK' noisy in register searches.
negative_findings.result_summary: Register lookups on the word fintech return an unrelated single company rather than the sector.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Actor discovery must be driven off licence-type register queries (platobná inštitúcia, poskytovateľ služieb kryptoaktív, AISP/PISP), not name keywords.

negative_findings.description: No annual report (výročná správa) of the Slovak Banking Association was found published on sbaonline.sk. Fetches of the homepage, /o-nas/ and /novinka/ surfaced press releases, statistics/analyses and project pages, but no annual-report archive or downloads section.
negative_findings.result_summary: SBA appears not to self-publish an annual report; its statutory financial statements would instead sit in registeruz.sk under IČO 30813182.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The workstream expects association annual reports as a direct disclosure type; for SK banking the substitute route is the state register, not the association site.

negative_findings.description: ALS SR site navigation (fetched) exposes members, statistics (SK/EU), documents, press releases, glossary, FAQ, videos and a vehicle register — but no annual report or publications section.
negative_findings.result_summary: Leasing association publishes recurring statistics but no annual report on its own domain.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Statistics are the valuable asset here; do not budget collection effort for a non-existent report series.

negative_findings.description: No dedicated Slovak payment service provider / e-money institution association was found. Searches in Slovak for a payments-specific association returned only the two general fintech bodies (Slovenská FinTech asociácia, FINAS) and the e-commerce association SAEC.
negative_findings.result_summary: Payments-industry self-regulation in SK appears to be handled inside SBA's expert commissions (14 commissions, 200+ specialists, including a payments area) rather than by a standalone PSP association.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Payments intelligence for SK must be sourced from SBA commissions plus the fintech associations; searching for a nonexistent SK equivalent of a payments association would waste cycles.

negative_findings.description: The 'bankový ombudsman SBA' — a term still widely used in SK banking glossaries — was abolished by the SBA members' assembly on 31 May 2018 and replaced from 1 July 2018 by the Inštitút alternatívneho riešenia sporov SBA.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searching 'bankový ombudsman' retrieves mostly obsolete bank-glossary pages, not a live source.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A noisy legacy term; collection must target institutars.sk, and any 'bankový ombudsman' material dated after mid-2018 should be treated as stale.

negative_findings.description: Several association URLs were taken from the NBS directory and search results without being fetched: institutars.sk, adss.sk, adds.sk, apsu.sk, afisp.sk, aocp.sk, ass.sk, saec.sk, itas.sk/clenovia, amcham.sk, sopk.sk, asins.sk, finas.sk. Some are listed by NBS as http-only, which may indicate outdated directory entries.
negative_findings.result_summary: Recorded as candidates with confidence scores below the fetched sources; liveness left to the deterministic verification pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Prevents overstating verification; http-only entries in a regulator directory are a common signal of redirects or moved sites, not of dead sources.

negative_findings.description: The NBS professional-associations directory lists the Slovak Insurance Association (SLASPO) via its ombudsman domain poistovaciombudsman.sk, and lists the asset-management association as 'www.ass.sk' while search results use the SASS branding. Canonical domains for these two bodies were not confirmed.
negative_findings.result_summary: Two association identities need a disambiguation pass before scheduled collection.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Registering the wrong canonical domain would silently produce empty crawls.

negative_findings.description: SBA membership counts differ across its own pages: the EN about page states 29 members (25 banks), the SK about page states 24 members, and the members directory enumerates 24 (20 full + 4 associate). Sector coverage is stated as ~99% (SK) vs 100% by assets (EN).
negative_findings.result_summary: Member counts are not internally consistent; the enumerated directory is the most reliable of the three.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Any headline figure quoted from SBA must cite the enumerated member list and its retrieval date, not the prose about-page numbers.

coverage_gaps.description: Branch-form banks (mBank S.A. pobočka, UniCredit Bank CZ&SK pobočka, Fio, J&T) lack confirmed SK-language disclosure hubs.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a dedicated sub-pass per branch entity: check parent-country IR site, registeruz.sk by IČO, and the SK site's 'povinne zverejňované informácie' page.

coverage_gaps.description: SK subsidiaries mostly publish annually/semi-annually; quarterly and outlook material for Slovakia exists mainly in parent-group IR (Erste, Intesa, KBC, RBI) and their earnings-call transcripts.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Register the four parent IR sites as separate quarterly-cadence sources and add transcript sources for Slovakia-segment analyst Q&A.

coverage_gaps.description: ESEF/XHTML machine-readable filings were observed for Tatra banka and 365.bank but not confirmed for the others; most collection would otherwise be PDF parsing.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: For each bank, check whether an ESEF/XHTML package is published alongside the PDF and prefer it for structured extraction.

coverage_gaps.description: Payments-specific disclosure (card volumes, instant payments, POS/acquiring) is not separately searched in this pass — it sits inside annual reports and CSR/sustainability reports rather than in dedicated pages.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add a sub-pass with sk terms 'platobné karty', 'okamžité platby', 'akceptácia platobných kariet', 'POS terminály' against the same bank domains.

coverage_gaps.description: Several banks serve documents from hashed or ID-suffixed paths (365.bank /media/{hash}/, primabanka /preview-file/*-NNNN.pdf) that break silently when re-published.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Snapshot every harvested PDF locally and record web.archive.org captures; do not rely on stable remote URLs.

coverage_gaps.description: 365.bank is mid-transition: KBC announced acquisition of ~98.45% from the J&T side. Its disclosure channel will migrate from J&T Finance Group's annual report to KBC's International Markets/Slovakia quarterly line, and the handover date and treatment (when it enters KBC's Slovakia segment; KBC's 2Q2026 Slovakia result already flags EUR 16m from 'recent acquisitions') were not established.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Track KBC IR closing/completion announcements and the first quarterly report in which 365.bank is consolidated; keep the J&T annual report in scope for pre-closing history and build an explicit before/after continuity note so the SK series is not broken by the reclassification.

coverage_gaps.description: Regulated-news / ad-hoc disclosure feeds of the parents (Vienna Stock Exchange and OeKB for Erste and RBI, Euronext Brussels/STORI for KBC, Borsa Italiana/eMarket SDIR-Storage for Intesa) were not searched. These carry the legally definitive, timestamped version of results and M&A announcements — often before the IR website is updated.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add a dedicated discovery pass for the national officially-appointed mechanisms (OAMs) and exchange news services covering AT, BE, IT issuers, and register the machine-readable ESEF/XBRL filings there.

coverage_gaps.description: ESEF/XBRL structured annual filings and Pillar 3 / country-by-country reporting (CRD Art. 89) were not scouted. CBCR is the one parent disclosure that legally mandates a per-country breakout — turnover, profit before tax, tax paid, employees for Slovakia — for every one of Erste, RBI, KBC, Intesa and UniCredit, on a fully comparable basis.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a targeted pass for each parent's Pillar 3 / CBCR annex and ESEF filing packages; CBCR gives an apples-to-apples SK country series that survives segment redefinitions and covers UniCredit's otherwise invisible SK unit.

coverage_gaps.description: Smaller SK banks with foreign parents were outside the named cell list and were not scouted: mBank (Commerzbank-linked, SK branch), Oberbank AG SK branch, BKS Bank SK, ING Bank N.V. SK branch, Citibank Europe plc SK branch, Fio banka SK, Komercni banka's SK branch, and consumer-finance arms (BNP Paribas Personal Finance/Cetelem, Home Credit SK).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Extend the cell in a follow-up pass to branch-model banks whose only disclosure is at foreign-parent level; note most publish nothing SK-specific, so CBCR and NBS branch statistics will be the practical substitutes.

coverage_gaps.description: Earnings-call transcripts, Q&A audio/webcasts and analyst pre-consensus were identified as existing (Erste audio/video webcasts, KBC replay webinars and sell-side preconsensus) but not scouted as sources in their own right. Analyst Q&A is where parents are pressed on the Slovak bank levy, mortgage repricing and competitive response — detail absent from written reports.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Scout transcript/webcast sources (issuer webcast archives first; third-party transcript aggregators noted separately with licensing caveats) and treat Slovakia-tagged Q&A exchanges as a distinct evidence type.

coverage_gaps.description: Parent-language (non-English) IR editions were not scouted: German for Erste/RBI, Italian for Intesa, Dutch for KBC. These sometimes publish earlier, and Italian/Dutch releases occasionally carry subsidiary detail trimmed from the English edition.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add DE/IT/NL query variants (e.g. 'Segment Slowakei', 'controllate estere Slovacchia', 'Internationale Markten Slowakije') in a follow-up pass and compare against the English editions for content deltas.

coverage_gaps.description: TREND (trend.sk) and Hospodárske noviny (hnonline.sk) — the two flagship Slovak business outlets named in this cell — were both left unverified: one refused the fetch, the other returned no search hits.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Re-attempt both with a browser-grade fetch (real UA, JS rendering), read robots.txt, and locate their finance section indexes and any RSS feeds. Do not mark either as dead on the current evidence.

coverage_gaps.description: The payments/technology media channel (Živé.sk and peers) produced no verified URLs, leaving payment-rail news (instant payments, QR schemes, wallets, outages) under-sourced relative to the earnings side.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Directly fetch zive.sk section/tag pages for 'banky' and 'platby', and additionally scout Touchit.sk, DSL.sk and Vosveteit.sk as alternative Slovak tech outlets covering payments.

coverage_gaps.description: Per-actor monitoring endpoints were confirmed for only two banks (SITA /firmy-institucie/tatra-banka/, SME /index/tatra-banka). Equivalent tag pages for Slovenská sporiteľňa, VÚB, ČSOB, Prima banka, 365.bank/Poštová banka, mBank and Fio were not enumerated.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Enumerate and record the tag-page URL for every tracked Slovak bank on SITA and SME; these are far cheaper to poll than whole-site crawls.

coverage_gaps.description: TASR and SITA full wire feeds are commercial products; no pricing, feed format or licensing terms were established in this run.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Request commercial terms from TASR and SITA for a monitoring licence; in the interim rely on teraz.sk (free TASR outlet) and the public sita.sk verticals.

coverage_gaps.description: Slovak subsidiaries of foreign groups (Erste/Slovenská sporiteľňa, Intesa/VÚB, RBI/Tatra banka, KBC/ČSOB) are also reported on by Austrian, Italian and Czech media on group results days, and no such outlet was scouted here.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add a scouting pass on parent-group media/IR calendars (Erste, Intesa Sanpaolo, RBI, KBC) since Slovak segment figures often surface there first and in English.

coverage_gaps.description: No archival or full-text-search backend for Slovak media (e.g. a press-monitoring/clipping service or a national media archive) was identified, so historical back-runs of earnings commentary are not addressable.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Scout Slovak media-monitoring vendors (e.g. Newton Media, Monitora) and the possibility of a licensed archive for retrospective coverage.

coverage_gaps.description: Parent-group (Erste Group, Intesa Sanpaolo, RBI, KBC, UniCredit) analyst material and country-segment reporting on their Slovak subsidiaries was not yet scouted in this pass.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a dedicated pass over group IR sites and equity-analyst coverage for SK segment disclosures on SLSP, VÚB, Tatra banka, ČSOB SK, UniCredit SK.

coverage_gaps.description: Payments-sector analyst/consultancy coverage of Slovakia (acquirers, PSPs, card schemes, instant payments) is far thinner in the results than banking coverage.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Targeted searches on 'platobné inštitúcie', 'akceptácia kariet', 'instant payments Slovensko', plus PwC/Capgemini/McKinsey payments reports with SK/CEE cuts.

coverage_gaps.description: Slovak think tanks and academic/economic-institute analyses of the banking sector (e.g. INESS, IFP/Inštitút finančnej politiky, university economics faculties) were not covered.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Search sk-language for 'analýza bankového sektora', 'bankový odvod', 'IFP komentár banky' and evaluate as independent domestic analysts.

coverage_gaps.description: Fitch Ratings' actual SK bank-level entity pages were not located directly; coverage was inferred from secondary reporting.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Query fitchratings.com entity search for each SK bank name and record entity IDs or a confirmed negative.

coverage_gaps.description: The Slovak Banking Association (Slovenská banková asociácia) own analytical output was not isolated in this pass; results were dominated by NBS.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Direct visit to sbaonline.sk for statistics, position papers and sector commentary as an industry aggregator.

coverage_gaps.description: Public procurement notices of the state financial entities (Úrad pre verejné obstarávanie / Vestník verejného obstarávania) were not searched in this pass, although they are the richest indirect channel for IT, self-service and payments-hardware demand from SZRB, EXIMBANKA and Slovenská konsolidačná.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a dedicated sk-language pass on uvo.gov.sk (vestník, profil verejného obstarávateľa) per entity IČO and add resulting sources.

coverage_gaps.description: Other public-interest financial actors were not covered: Slovenská pošta / Poštová banka relationship, Slovenská sporiteľňa's public-sector role, Štátna pokladnica (pokladnica.sk), Agentúra pre riadenie dlhu a likvidity (ARDAL), and the Ministry of Economy's own state vehicles.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Extend the actor map to Štátna pokladnica and ARDAL, which run state payment and treasury infrastructure directly relevant to payments intelligence.

coverage_gaps.description: Back-catalogue depth was confirmed for EXIMBANKA (reports linked back to 2006) but not established for SZRB, SIH or Slovenská konsolidačná beyond recent years on their own sites.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Use registeruz.sk per-IČO filing history and web.archive.org snapshots to establish full multi-year series for each entity.

coverage_gaps.description: No Hungarian- or German-language channels were sought; these are unlikely to matter for SK state-entity disclosure but were not tested.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Deprioritise unless a cross-border export-finance angle (EXIMBANKA partner ECAs) becomes relevant.

coverage_gaps.description: No coverage yet of payment-processing / card-issuing-platform vendors serving SK banks (e.g. OpenWay, BPC/SmartVista, Tieto/TietoEVRY Card Suite, Comtrade, Monet+, Trask, Sofort/Nexi-type processors).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run targeted vendor-by-vendor searches pairing each platform name with SK bank names and with 'Slovensko'; check TietoEVRY and BPC customer pages, which historically list CEE issuers.

coverage_gaps.description: Vendor earnings-call transcripts and investor decks were not mined; SK wins are often mentioned verbally rather than in press releases.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add transcript sources (vendor IR webcast pages, SEC filings for Diebold Nixdorf/Brink's-Atleos/Euronet/Worldline) and keyword-search transcripts for 'Slovak'.

coverage_gaps.description: Vendor and bank hiring/partner signals (LinkedIn posts, job ads naming core systems, partner directories) not yet catalogued as indirect sources.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add SK job boards (profesia.sk) and LinkedIn company pages as indirect sources; search job ads for system names (e.g. 'eStarBANK', 'Temenos', 'SmartVista') to infer bank-vendor pairings.

coverage_gaps.description: Smaller SK banks and branches of foreign banks (Prima banka, Tatra banka's RBI stack, 365.bank, ČSOB, mBank SK, Fio, Slovenská záručná a rozvojová banka) not yet mapped to named vendors.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build a bank-by-vendor matrix and search each bank name against each major vendor domain (site: queries) in both SK and EN.

coverage_gaps.description: The exact RÚZ public API/bulk endpoints and the ekosystém SQL-dump download URLs were referenced in secondary summaries but their concrete endpoint paths and rate/licence conditions were not read from primary documentation in this pass.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Fetch registeruz.sk FAQ/API documentation and ekosystem.slovensko.digital/podmienky directly and record endpoint paths, refresh cadence and licence text.

coverage_gaps.description: Bank-specific supervisory reporting archives (NBS prudential/statistical data warehouse, ECB/EBA data portals mirroring SK institution data) were not covered here; they belong to a supervisory cell but are the natural machine-readable complement to corporate filings.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Ensure a sibling cell covers NBS statistical datasets and ECB/EBA data portals for SK credit institutions; cross-link with this cell's entity keys.

coverage_gaps.description: No LEI-to-IČO crosswalk source was identified for SK financial institutions, which is required to join local register data to GLEIF/ECB/EBA datasets.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Search GLEIF Level-1 records filtered to SK and check whether the local registration authority field carries IČO; build and version the crosswalk.

coverage_gaps.description: Coverage depth of Slovak bank IR domains inside Internet Archive and webdepozit.sk was not measured; it is unknown how many withdrawn annual reports are actually recoverable.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run CDX API counts per major SK bank domain (PDF paths, IR paths) to quantify recoverability before relying on archives for back-fill.

coverage_gaps.description: Video/audio archives beyond the TechEvents YouTube channel were not enumerated - individual bank YouTube channels, ITAPA session recordings and podcast formats (where CEOs speak at length) remain unmapped.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a dedicated sk pass on 'podcast bankovnictvo Slovensko', 'zaznam konferencie', and per-bank YouTube channels; capture channel IDs for API-based transcript collection.

coverage_gaps.description: Non-bank SK payment actors (PSPs, acquirers, softPOS vendors, e-money institutions) were only reached indirectly via association pages; no member directory was retrieved.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Fetch the FINAS member list and NBS register of payment/e-money institutions, then check each actor for conference-speaking and award participation.

coverage_gaps.description: Historical depth is thin: only ~2023-2026 editions of the awards and conferences were surfaced, though Zlata minca runs since 2005 and TREND's awards for 27+ years.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Backfill via site archives and the Wayback Machine to build a 10-year longitudinal award/winner series usable as a competitive-position proxy.

coverage_gaps.description: English-language SK event surfaces (international editions, CEE conferences where SK banks speak, e.g. Finweek Kuala Lumpur, FinTech Roadmap) were only lightly covered.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add an en-language pass targeting CEE/EU payment conferences with SK speaker participation to catch expansion and roadmap statements made abroad.

coverage_gaps.description: No award-submission documents themselves were located - only nomination lists and result press releases. Submission dossiers (where the richest unpublished numbers would sit) may not be public at all.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Contact organisers (Zlata minca, Mastercard/Visa SK, TREND) to establish whether submission summaries or jury materials are ever published; otherwise record as structurally unavailable.

coverage_gaps.description: This cell yields the filing channel but not the entity list; no consolidated IČO watchlist of SK banks, foreign-bank branches, payment institutions, EMIs and payment agents was assembled in this pass.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build a watchlist by crawling the NBS PSD2 register and supervised-entity lists, resolving each name to an IČO via the RPO API, then feeding it to the RÚZ/ORSR collectors.

coverage_gaps.description: Branches of foreign banks (organizačné zložky) and cross-border PSD2 passported providers may have reduced or no standalone filing duty in the SK register, so their SK activity may be invisible in RÚZ.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Test coverage empirically for 3-5 known branches; where absent, fall back to parent-group reporting and NBS aggregate statistics (other cells).

coverage_gaps.description: RÚZ is documented as CC0 and RPO as CC BY 4.0, but the aggregator layers (Slovensko.Digital, FinStat, FOAF) carry their own terms whose commercial-use conditions were not established.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Review each aggregator's ToS/pricing before any commercial market-intel redistribution; default to the official CC0/CC-BY sources for anything published.

coverage_gaps.description: The richest narrative content (výročná správa, poznámky, správa audítora) arrives as PDF attachments; structure and OCR quality across banks were not sampled.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Sample annual-report attachments for 3-5 SK banks to assess whether text layers exist and whether IFRS note tables are extractable.

coverage_gaps.description: Filings before the 2014 reform were published in the Obchodný vestník / zbierka listín rather than RÚZ; the earliest reliable year of RÚZ coverage for financial-sector entities was not established.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Probe the RÚZ API for the earliest available statement years for a few banks; plan an Obchodný vestník archive route for pre-2014 series if long time series are required.

coverage_gaps.description: Only the three largest banks (Slovenská sporiteľňa, VÚB, Tatra banka) were mapped to issuer-side disclosure hubs. Smaller regulated issuers likely in scope — Prima banka, 365.bank/Poštová banka, ČSOB SK, UniCredit Bank Czech Republic and Slovakia (SK branch), Slovenská záručná a rozvojová banka — were not individually verified.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Pull the NBS 'Zoznam bánk emitujúcich kryté dlhopisy' as the authoritative issuer roster, then run one targeted sk-language pass per bank on the pattern '<bank> prospekt kryté dlhopisy' and '<bank> emisné podmienky dlhopisy'.

coverage_gaps.description: No commercial aggregator of Slovak regulated disclosure (e.g. financial data vendors, Slovak business-intelligence services such as FinStat or Cribis that resell RÚZ/ORSR data) was assessed in this cell.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Scout the SK commercial aggregator layer separately; it can offer normalized, API-accessible versions of RÚZ/ORSR data that would cut engineering cost, subject to licence terms.

coverage_gaps.description: The CERI search interface's URL/parameter structure, pagination behaviour, and whether issuer filings can be filtered by IČO or LEI were not inspected — only the static documentation pages were read.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a browser-driven exploration of ceri.nbs.sk search to capture the query-string schema and confirm whether results are server-rendered (scrapable) or JS/XHR-driven (needs the underlying JSON endpoint, which may be a de-facto API even if undocumented).

coverage_gaps.description: Pillar 3 / prudential disclosure (zverejňovanie informácií podľa CRR, 'informácie o banke' under NBS opatrenie) was not scouted, although it is the disclosure stream carrying capital, liquidity and operational-risk detail for SK banks and is legally distinct from Transparency-Directive filings.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add a dedicated pass on 'zverejňovanie informácií bankou podľa opatrenia NBS', 'Pillar 3 správa banka Slovensko', and each bank's 'Informácie o banke' page.

coverage_gaps.description: Foreign listing venues and foreign OAMs potentially holding disclosure for Slovak bank instruments were not covered (see negative finding on foreign listings).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Query issuer prospectuses for the 'admission to trading' clause to identify the actual venue(s), then add the corresponding OAM to the collection map.

coverage_gaps.description: NBS macroprudential and SREP disclosure stream — O-SII designations, countercyclical capital buffer (proticyklický kapitálový vankúš) decisions, systemic risk buffer, and any published Pillar 2 requirements per institution.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a dedicated pass over nbs.sk/financna-stabilita/ and the macroprudential policy decisions section using SK terms: 'proticyklický kapitálový vankúš', 'vankúš na krytie systémového rizika', 'O-SII', 'rozhodnutie NBS o kapitálovom vankúši'.

coverage_gaps.description: Only 8 of roughly 25-30 SK banks and foreign-bank branches have a located disclosure entry point. Small banks, state-owned SZRB, building societies and EU-passported branches are largely uncovered.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Derive the full entity list from registre.nbs.sk / the ECB LSI list, then do a per-domain navigation pass looking for the SK section names 'Povinne zverejňované informácie', 'Informácie o banke', 'Finančné ukazovatele', 'Ostatné informácie'.

coverage_gaps.description: The EBA Pillar 3 Data Hub went live 26 Jan 2026, moving EEA Pillar 3 from per-bank PDFs to centralised structured DPM data. It is unclear which SK institutions are already onboarded and whether banks will keep mirroring PDFs on their own sites.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Determine the P3DH access mechanism (API vs portal download), check SK institution coverage by LEI, and plan a dual-run period keeping PDF scraping as a bridge. Track the small/non-complex-institution discussion paper outcome.

coverage_gaps.description: Coverage is banking-heavy. The payments side of sector=both has only the NBS PSD2/e-money register, because payment and e-money institutions are outside CRR Pillar 3 and have no equivalent prudential disclosure series.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Reframe the payments prudential-disclosure equivalent as (a) NBS PSD2 register deltas, (b) safeguarding/own-funds requirements disclosed in statutory accounts filed to Register účtovných závierok, and (c) NBS enforcement decisions. Map Register účtovných závierok (registeruz.sk) as a source.

coverage_gaps.description: Register účtovných závierok (registeruz.sk), the mandatory Slovak financial-statements register, was not explored despite being the statutory filing destination for FOV, GFI, banks and payment institutions, and having a known open-data API.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Map registeruz.sk and its bulk/open-data API in a follow-up pass; it is likely the highest-yield structured backfill for the whole workstream, not just this cell.

coverage_gaps.description: English-language Pillar 3 availability is confirmed only for VÚB (parallel _EN PDF series). It is unknown whether Slovenská sporiteľňa, Tatra banka, ČSOB or others publish EN versions, or whether EN coverage exists only at group level (Erste, RBI, KBC).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: For each SK bank, check for an EN mirror and, where absent, check the parent group's consolidated Pillar 3 (Erste Group, RBI, KBC, Intesa Sanpaolo) for a Slovak-subsidiary section.

coverage_gaps.description: No URL in this slice has been liveness-verified; several (365.bank disclosure section, the subjekty.nbs.sk PSD2 JSON endpoint, the NBS '/historia/' resolution pages) are inferred from search snippets or path patterns rather than observed directly.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Route all candidates through the deterministic verification pass; treat 403/timeout as bot-defence rather than death, and re-locate any 404 via site search before marking it dead.

coverage_gaps.description: The full roster of SK-licensed inštitúcie elektronických peňazí (including 'IEP v obmedzenom rozsahu' / limited-scope EMIs) has not been extracted.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Pull the sector=2 listing from subjekty.nbs.sk and the /api/psd2 + /api/cl endpoints programmatically and classify by licence-type code, rather than relying on narrative regulator pages.

coverage_gaps.description: EEA payment/e-money institutions passporting services INTO Slovakia (a large part of the real SK payments market, e.g. Revolut-type players) were not enumerated.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Extract EBA EUCLID PIR filtered on host country = SK, then attach each firm's home-market annual report and press-release channel; note that their disclosures are published in the home country and language, not in SK.

coverage_gaps.description: No IČO-to-RÚZ-entity-id mapping has been built, so licence records and financial filings are not yet joinable.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build a resolver keyed on IČO joining NBS PSD2 feed -> ORSR extract -> registeruz.sk entity page, and store historic names (e.g. SPPS, a. s. -> SKPAY, a. s.) to keep time series continuous.

coverage_gaps.description: At least one major actor (Trust Pay, a. s.) reports on a non-calendar fiscal year ending 30 September, which will misalign naive year-over-year comparisons.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Capture the fiscal-year-end per entity from the filing metadata and normalise before any comparison.

coverage_gaps.description: MiCA crypto-asset service providers licensed by NBS from 30 Dec 2025 form an adjacent payments-like population that this cell did not enumerate.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add the NBS 'Trh kryptoaktív' sector of subjekty.nbs.sk as a second register sweep and decide explicitly whether CASPs are in or out of the payments cell.

coverage_gaps.description: NBS/ECB payment statistics (transaction volumes and values by instrument for SK) were not scouted in this pass, though they are the natural denominator for individual PI performance.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Scout NBS 'štatistika platobného styku' and the ECB Payments Statistics dataset for SK in a follow-up cell.

coverage_gaps.description: First Data legacy estate in SK was only traced as far as the First Data -> SIA Central Europe -> Nexi Central Europe lineage (ICO 31372074). Any residual Fiserv (First Data successor) presence in SK - e.g. Fiserv/Clover distribution or a separate SK entity - was not searched.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run targeted sk+en queries on 'Fiserv Slovensko', 'Clover Slovensko', 'First Data Slovakia' and check ORSR/registeruz for Fiserv-named entities.

coverage_gaps.description: Bank-owned/bank-branded acquiring in SK beyond the Erste/SLSP-Global Payments JV was not mapped: Tatra banka, VUB (Intesa), CSOB (KBC), Postova banka/365.bank acceptance offerings and which processor sits behind each.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: For each major SK bank, crawl the merchant/'prijimanie platieb kartou' pages and identify the named acquirer/processor; cross-check against the ZBK member list.

coverage_gaps.description: Public procurement (UVO - Urad pre verejne obstaravanie / vestnik) was not searched. Tenders for card acceptance and POS terminal services by SK public bodies would name bidders, award values and per-transaction pricing.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add UVO vestnik keyword monitoring for 'akceptacia platobnych kariet', 'platobne terminaly', 'sluzby akceptacie kariet' alongside CRZ contract monitoring.

coverage_gaps.description: No conference/industry-event source was harvested for this cell beyond noting ZBK's /podujatia page. Event agendas and speaker lists are a reliable way to discover processors, gateway vendors and terminal OEMs active in SK.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Harvest ZBK event agendas and any SK payments conference programmes; snowball speaker company names into the actor register.

coverage_gaps.description: The May 2026 SK QR-payment / notifikacne ucty (NOP) rollout by Financna sprava and major banks was seen only in passing. It is a structural threat/alternative to card acceptance and directly relevant to acquirer and terminal-estate economics in SK.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add Financna sprava SR (financnasprava.sk) and the NOP/QR programme pages as a monitored source and assess its effect on terminal-estate growth.

coverage_gaps.description: Slovak-language coverage was achieved for all local actors, registries and media. However, no Hungarian- or Czech-language searching was done, despite Nexi Central Europe running SK from a shared CZ/HU/HR/RS platform - CZ-language disclosure often carries SK-relevant operational detail.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add a Czech-language query pass ('Nexi Ceska republika zpracovani karet', 'Global Payments Europe s.r.o. vyrocni zprava') to capture shared-platform disclosures.

coverage_gaps.description: No card-clearing/switching or ATM-network operator for Slovakia was identified in this pass (domestic switch, ATM interchange consortium, or card processor serving SK banks).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run targeted Slovak queries on 'spracovanie platobných kariet', 'bankomatová sieť', 'autorizačné centrum' and check NBS 'systems under oversight' for card schemes.
